definitions.explanation: The movement of troops toward a destination or enemy position. Also used figuratively for determined forward progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{進軍|しんぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The soldiers continued their march through bad weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}い→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{進軍|しんぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}めなかった→緩める：15263_yurumeru⟧。
examples.english: Despite encountering fierce enemy resistance, they did not slow the pace of their advance.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a military term, but sometimes used figuratively for determined progress in business or competitions. The well-known military song ⟦{軍艦|ぐんかん}→軍艦：14393_gunkan⟧{行進曲|こうしんきょく} is sometimes colloquially called {進軍|しんぐん}⟦ラッパ→ラッパ：09958_rappa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進軍|しんぐん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to advance, to march)
- {進軍|しんぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue the advance)
- {進軍|しんぐん}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ (pace of advance)
- {進軍|しんぐん}⟦ラッパ→ラッパ：09958_rappa⟧ (bugle call to advance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行軍|こうぐん}: march — focuses on the act of marching rather than advancing toward an enemy
- ⟦{侵攻|しんこう}→侵攻：11614_shinkou⟧: invasion — advancing into enemy territory
